# URL to markdown

The Apify actor [`apify/url-to-markdown`](https://apify.com/apify/url-to-markdown) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.1.7**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

An Apify Actor that takes a URL as input and returns the content of the page in Markdown format.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Converted page $0.003, Converted JS-rendered page $0.006, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/url-to-markdown) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-url-to-markdown@0.1.7#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      url: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | yes |  | URL — Enter the URL of a specific web page to extract its content in Markdown format. |
| `scrapingTool` | string |  | `"raw-http"` | Scraping mode — Select the scraping mode for extracting the target web pages. The Raw HTTP mode (default) is the fastest, but can't handle JavaScript. The Browser mode is more powerful, can handle JavaScript heavy websites, but costs more. |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object |  | `{"useApifyProxy":true}` | Proxy configuration — Apify Proxy configuration used for scraping the target web pages. |
| `removeElementsCssSelector` | string |  | `"nav, footer, script, style, noscript, svg, img[src^='data:'` | Remove HTML elements (CSS selector) — A CSS selector matching HTML elements that will be removed from the DOM, before converting it to text, Markdown, or saving as HTML. This is useful to skip irrelevant page content. The value must be a valid CSS selector as accepted by the `document.querySelectorA |
| `desiredConcurrency` | integer |  | `1` | Desired browsing concurrency — The desired number of web browsers running in parallel. The system automatically scales the number based on the CPU and memory usage. If the initial value is `0`, the Actor picks the number automatically based on the available memory. |
| `debugMode` | boolean |  | `false` | Enable debug mode — If enabled, the Actor will store debugging information into the resulting dataset under the `debug` field. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
